race.comment: CHIEF OF WAR (4) has been hard to fault this time in work. Opened with a couple of close seconds then was ridden quietly in a small field last start over the mile at Wagga then sprinted impressively for an easy win. Equally at home on a rain affected track so he should keep the good form rolling. KOKONDA (5) opened this prep in tremendous form before finding a $100k race over the mile at Bendigo last Sunday a bit too tough. Big chance to make amends in this more suitable contest on a six-day back-up. SUPER PARADISE (3) wasn't far away at massive odds in that $100k Bendigo feature last weekend. Good wet tracker ready to peak at the third run back from a spell. FAIR MASTER (6) is up in grade but was impressive over this trip last time out.
